nom: e.l.f. Cosmetics Glass Slick Serum Stick - Bounce + Plump Peptide Blend

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin mostly report it works if applied with a light hand and gives a subtle, non-shimmery glow, but at least one warns the product is not suited to very oily or greasy skin since it can look oily rather than glassy.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one who calls her dryness severe, report it as a hydration game-changer that leaves skin soft and glowing, though one reviewer in a dry climate found it didn't provide enough hydration or plumping for her needs.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report good results applying it selectively to their drier areas, though one cautions that combination skin needs a light hand or the finish can turn greasy rather than dewy.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as more mature, including some in their 40s, report the product visibly plumps and softens fine lines and crow's feet and doesn't settle into creases, though it's used mainly for glow and hydration rather than as a dramatic anti-aging treatment.

concerns.aging: Some reviewers using it on fine lines, laugh lines and crow's feet report the appearance of those lines visibly plumped and softened with repeated use, but at least one reviewer says she didn't notice any plumping effect at all.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report a genuine hydration boost, with skin left feeling soft, smooth and glowing after use, though a couple of reviewers, including one with dry skin, felt it wasn't enough moisture and saw no real difference.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no negative skin reactions, but one reviewer with acne-prone skin says her acne flared up every time she used it and would not recommend it for that reason.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin generally like the subtle, non-shiny glow when it's applied sparingly, but multiple reviewers warn that using too much, or using it at all on very oily or greasy skin, can tip the finish from dewy into visibly oily.

aspects.libelle: Feels too heavy in summer heat
Can smear or lift makeup applied on top
Doubles well as a highlighter over makeup
Little product in the tube for the price
Can ball up or feel tacky at first use

extraits.texte: I have to say I am disappointed in this product, I love elf products, I have many, I buy many, I buy them regularly, but this one especially for the price just is not at all as described. It leaves like an oily feel on your face, even if you use very little of it. It doesn't give your face the glass look it looks oily. It feels just like the holy hydration makeup primer stick only with oil. It's not worth that much money to get it and then it not be as described. It says in the description that it is not oily and doesn't feel oily but yet it is and it does. I hate leaving any kind of bad or negative reviews I try to be kind about it and I am always 100% honest and when I leave reviews I want whom ever else is interested in a product that I have had and tried myself to know my experience with it. I rely heavily on reviews when ordering things offline. 🤷🏼‍♀️🙅🏼‍♀️🤦🏼‍♀️

I have been trying the serum stick for the last week and I am not a fan. It says it does not clog pores so it should be good for many skin types but each time I have used it, my acne has flared up. I have tried it under my makeup and it made my base look weird where I applied it. I also tried it overtop of my makeup at the high points on my face and it just makes the makeup there melt off hours quicker than the rest of my face. I think this product is just not for me.

I received the glass stick serum for free in exchange for writing a review. I really liked this product. I think it has versatile uses. It gives a glass look for sure. I like it better as a topper than under makeup. I don't wear much makeup during hot summer days and I used it without makeup more. The dewy look without shimmer was nice as a highlighter. Would I buy it? Probably not unless I really find myself using it a lot as a highlighter. I didn't notice any plumping. I didn't love it under my makeup or notice anything that was very different without it. I don't know that I'd recommend it unless someone was looking for a highlighter that wasn't shimmery.

I waa given the opportunity to try this stick out in exchange for my honest opinion. It took a few weeks of use but I finally feel like I can endorse this product they way it deserves. I will start off by saying I wouldn't say I have mature skin but my skin has seen some time and evidence of that has started to show. Mostly in the form of laugh lines, crows feet and other small fine lines. I have never been a fan of heavy moisturizers or serum so I was surprised I kind of liked that about this product. It has a heavier formula but what I found was that heavy mess allowed the product to stay in place throughout the day and that allowed it time for it to work its magic. I only used the stick on certain areas of my face, around my eyes, center of forehead and around my mouth. Given time to sink in and melt into my skin this product really payer off. Especially with the delicate skin around my eyes. My laugh lines and crows feet around my eyes have plumped up and reduced the appearance of my fine lines and wrinklses. Visibly my skin looks younger while makeup application has become a breeze without it settling in the lines and wrinkles around my eyes. I plan to continue use of this stick to see even more long term improvements. I have been a elf girl for many years now and with products like this I will continue to be an elf girl for many more to come.

I received this product as a free sample from buzz agent to test it out. First off, I love elf products! I have so many, you just can't beat the price and the quality is awesome. I will say, this product feels quite dense going on. It makes an amazing serum for dry skin! I am planning on saving this stick for winter, when the moisture is sucked out of my skin. But for summer, I feel like this product is too heavy for my skin. I usually switch to a very light moisturizer during these humid months.

First of all, I'm a male, and I received this product through BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. The finish is very natural. I have oily skin, so I was a bit hesitant to use it on my face at first, but it doesn't look sparkly or overly "feminine" at all — just a healthy, subtle glow. I actually found that it works really well on the body too. The stick format makes it super easy to apply on areas like the arms and chest. Especially in the summer, when you want that hydrated, glossy look without visible shimmer, this product does a great job.
